name: wovemind
description: Open-source Claude Code plugins: skills, agents and hooks for web, mobile and AI app development.

plugins.name: htmx-vs-alpine
plugins.description: Guides Claude to choose between HTMX and Alpine.js for client-side interactivity in server-rendered web applications.

plugins.name: fastapi-template
plugins.description: Scaffolds a complete FastAPI + Jinja2 + HTMX + Alpine.js web app skeleton with PostgreSQL/Alembic, Redis caching, OpenRouter AI, uv, and Railway Procfile.

plugins.name: go-webapp-template
plugins.description: Scaffolds a complete Go (net/http + html/template) + HTMX + Alpine.js web app skeleton with PostgreSQL/pgx + goose migrations, Redis caching, OpenRouter AI, and Railway Procfile. Go counterpart of fastapi-template, no Python. Includes fastapi-go-migration: migrate an existing fastapi-template project to this stack in place.

plugins.name: plan-tools
plugins.description: Plan-driven workflow tools: bootstrap a new web or mobile app end to end, split implementation plans into context-sized resumable sessions, and drive them to PRs.

plugins.name: ntfy
plugins.description: Send push notifications to phone/desktop via ntfy.sh or a self-hosted ntfy instance over its HTTP API.

plugins.name: user-flows
plugins.description: Extract a deduplicated inventory of user flows from an application codebase into user-flows.md, as groundwork for generating automated tests.

plugins.name: product-experience-strategist
plugins.description: Expert product strategy, UX/UI and business development skill for designing, reviewing and improving digital products and end-to-end user flows.

plugins.name: desktop-notify
plugins.description: Send desktop notifications via the claude-notifier CLI when a task finishes or Claude needs user attention.

plugins.name: python-arq
plugins.description: Complete reference for the arq Python library (v0.28) — async job queues with asyncio and Redis: enqueueing, workers, retries, cron, results, and error flows.

plugins.name: launch-video
plugins.description: Turn an app repo into a launch/promo video: AI presenter intro/outro, real screen recordings, voice-over, and captions, for Android apps or web apps.

plugins.name: flagd
plugins.description: Complete reference for flagd, the OpenFeature feature-flag evaluation engine — flag definitions & JSON Logic targeting, fractional rollouts, deployment (Docker/k8s/systemd), sync sources, gRPC/OFREP APIs, and per-language OpenFeature providers.

plugins.name: openfeature
plugins.description: Complete reference for OpenFeature, the CNCF vendor-neutral feature-flag standard — spec concepts, providers, hooks, events, evaluation context, OFREP, CLI, MCP server and ecosystem, with deep-dive references for the Go, .NET (C#) and Python SDKs.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explain code and concepts in the current project, building only on topics the user already knows plus what earlier explanations covered, with ASCII diagrams and a per-topic learning log in ~/.explain_skill/.

plugins.name: ui-change-guard
plugins.description: Pre-push safety review for UX/UI changes in web and native/mobile apps (htmx/Alpine, React, React Native, SwiftUI, Compose, Flutter, Capacitor) — removed form fields the backend depends on, redesigned pages that lost functionality, performance regressions, broken htmx/Alpine wiring, a11y/security regressions, weakened tests. SAFE / UNSAFE verdict with issue list, PR-body engineer handoff, and an engineer-review skill.

plugins.name: compliance-audit
plugins.description: Audits a product repo for legal and regulatory compliance gaps (privacy across EU/UK/US/Israel/Singapore, app store rules, EU digital acts, payments, AI, minors, licensing/SBOM, security baseline) and publishes a claude.ai Artifact report with findings ranked by legal risk, file:line evidence, fixes, owners and shared fix statuses, then implements the open cards as dependency-ordered, auto-merged PRs. Not legal advice.

plugins.name: ui-audit
plugins.description: Visual UI-change audit for pull requests: before/after screenshots and motion clips of every screen that really changed (web via Playwright with mobile emulation; Capacitor and Expo via simulators), unintended changes flagged, published as a Claude artifact or to Cloudflare Pages behind a password, and linked from the PR.

plugins.name: design-inspiration
plugins.description: Design inspiration for the app in your repo: asks a few design questions, searches Dribbble, Awwwards and other free inspiration sites, optionally has you compare pairs of designs so it learns your taste, publishes a shortlist per app page as a claude.ai Artifact you rate Love / Maybe / No, optionally mocks up your pages in that look for comments, then plans how to apply the designs you picked.

plugins.name: session-overview
plugins.description: Side pane (/sessions) listing every open Claude Code session on the machine, grouped by project, with its goal and state.
